description.en: Concentric glass waves refract a forest painting behind a rotating starburst. Get Started opens a three-goal onboarding sheet.
description.zh: 同心玻璃波纹折射松林油画，星芒缓缓旋转。点击开始，可进入三项目标选择。

keywords: 玻璃 同心 波纹 折射 引导 金融 油画 松林 星芒 旋转 目标 选择 onboarding concentric glass ripple refraction forest painting Fresnel budget moizarshi29

useCases: 带玻璃折射背景与三项目标选择的产品引导卡片
An onboarding card with concentric refraction and local goal selection
discovery.caveat: 选择与确认仅为本地演示，可用 onContinue 接入应用。无 WebGL 时使用圈层缩放降级；原 HTML 与画作许可未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML and painting adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/WebGL core with six native framework entries. Goal selection and confirmation remain local demo states; no account or financial data is created.
source.license: No separate license was supplied or verified for the HTML or embedded painting.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Click the starburst or painting for an extra ripple. Use Get Started to choose a local demo goal and Continue to confirm it.
instructions.zh: 点击星芒或画作可追加波纹。点击 Get Started 选择演示目标，再用 Continue 确认。
